standard: VATTAMS Academia Competition Mastery Standard — Thirukkural Reference Model

reference_model.name: Thirukkural Mastery Championship
principles: Competition-specific curriculum rather than fixed-duration lessons
Domain → subtopic → learning resource → practice → mastery progression
Age/level appropriate learning paths where applicable
Large structured question bank mapped to curriculum
Mock-test preparation separate from official competition attempt
Official competition paper and scoring remain independently controlled
Content depth is determined by the competition syllabus, not an arbitrary lesson count

content_architecture.question_bank: competition-specific, curriculum-mapped, age/level tagged where applicable
content_architecture.official_attempt: separate from study materials and mock tests
